data.rationale: The proposal matches the true KOA search workflow (Filters, amenity checkbox, destination, optional dates, FIND A KOA) and names the right parameters, but it adds a max-distance parameter that isn't in the true workflow and puts the filter steps before the destination step, and it is a bit vague on the destination suggestion pick; a browser automation could still be built from it.
